scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable rough edges, 10 exceptional. Holistic judgments of these two observed emulated attempts, not win/loss grades or arithmetic claims.

reasons.overall_mobile: Strong atmosphere and useful planning/reach feedback support a playable touch adaptation, but aiming and cover navigation demanded repeated corrections and created significant exposure.
reasons.controls: Two contacts supported simultaneous movement and fire or careful USE; clear large targets. Fine aim and short positional corrections were difficult for this reviewer; dash helped.
reasons.gameplay: Recovering memories and combining dash/fire gave clear progress and tactical possibilities. Threat pressure while resolving navigation and reach was frustrating. Later mission systems unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Coherent restrained cyan/amber palette, rain, relay architecture and strong typography. Close surfaces sometimes dominated the view; no audio judgment.
reasons.usability: Helpful handbook, pause map, route line, zoom, receiver checkmarks, proximity instructions and visible fresh restart. Passage finding still took repeated failed moves.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, objectives and touch labels were readable; small terminal detail/world signage and overlapping transient information weakened clarity.

cleanup.verification_result: No rows; exit 1, both exact owned PIDs absent. No kill commands used.

helpful.detail: Centered enemy, amber optic and immediate induction hint made held FIRE understandable; enemy disappeared after firing.
Explicit outside-reach distance and HOLD USE slow movement enabled small two-contact corrections; attempt 2 recovery was earlier and with more health.
Paused route line, receiver selection, completed check marks, YOU arrow and local zoom helped correct overshoot and locate a path around cover.
Backing off a blocking surface, crossing around it, then dash and centered held fire was a satisfying successful sequence.
Cyan/amber accents, rainy relay setting, large SOULFALL title, strong headings and legible large touch labels establish a coherent mood.

frustrating.detail: Small enemies remained difficult to align with FIRE-drag, particularly while moving. Corrections consumed ammunition and exposure time; attempts ended at 8% and 14% accuracy. This is observed reviewer difficulty, not proof of a broken control.
Repeated close wall/cover views obscured orientation. Route line and north-opening hint did not immediately translate into a clear ground-level passage. Jump attempt gave no obvious solution.
Being almost in range while taking fire felt punishing, particularly the 0.2m miss in attempt 1 and 1.8m miss near death in attempt 2.

Large health/ammo and button labels read well at 844x390, but compass, terminal accuracy line and some world signage are small. Simultaneous threat banners, objective markers and controls compete with the scene.

not_covered: tools submenu, swap, crouch, run and AIM button
observations.assessment_boundary: Only observed opening/receiver combat and navigation are assessed. No inferred enjoyment of later content.
